bull.probability_evidence: Bull case: every multiple sits below its 5y minimum (EV/EBITDA 10.8x vs 12.2x floor, P/E 18.3x vs 19.4x floor); Q2 2026 delivered 8% organic growth and FY2026 guidance is 3%-4% organic/7% EPS growth vs the reverse-DCF-implied -3.3%; high-value categories ~45% of sales are lifting gross margin (+1.2pp to 29.0%); buybacks cut share count -3.08% YoY; beta 0.80 and Altman Z 3.54 argue for moderate downside (research/AVY/2026-10-09-evaluation.md Bull case).

base.probability_evidence: Evaluator's rationale: the discount to AVY's own history is real but rests on a TTM FCF margin (11.5%) that is probably flattered by working-capital timing vs FY2025's 8.0%, and AVY still trades above packaging peers on P/E/EV-EBITDA/EV-Sales, so conviction is capped at 3 (below the buy threshold of 4); the modal outcome is a partial re-rating toward the EV/EBITDA 5y floor (191.60) rather than the full DCF-blended base (213.64) (research/AVY/2026-10-09-evaluation.md Decision.rationale and scenarios.base.basis).

bear.probability_evidence: Bear case: ROIC fell from 18.4% (FY2021) to 15.1% TTM and ROE fell 13.2pp while net debt/EBITDA rose to 2.61x at FY2025; on P/E, EV/EBITDA and EV/Sales AVY still trades 28-36% above packaging peers; shares trail SPY by 18.9pp over 6 months; management already guides to destocking; Q3 results on Oct 29 are flagged as a near-term event risk (research/AVY/2026-10-09-evaluation.md Bear case).
